videoTitle: Your Work Crush Might Not Even Be Real—Here's Why
videoDescription: Think you're falling for a coworker? The intensity might have nothing to do with them. We break down why workplace attraction feels so charged—and what to check before you act on it. Find the full guide at mindtivate.com
script: You think it's about him, but here's what's actually happening: workplace crushes feel intense because of scarcity and anticipation. Every interaction is brief and constrained, which makes those moments feel more charged than they actually...
